review_findings.detail: The retained-client schema now permits only the exact three existing Desktop identity policy files, only when both generated manifests classify each solely as electron_process_graph. It requires client_responsibility, exact base/head hashes, reviewer/reference/status, and compatibility boundary; it rejects rust_authority on retained_client records and confines associated_backend_authority to this role. New Desktop runtime files and backend authority changes remain denied by the original ratchet.

Source review confirms the old packaged auth-bypass truth table is unchanged and independent of memory storage. The memory-store output requires packaged app, Rudder-smoke name, valid packaged test marker, Darwin, memory mode, and the explicit storage-only flag. Default packaged safeStorage remains native; packaged Darwin process-memory fallback remains false without the scoped mode; existing unpackaged/Linux fallback behavior is preserved.

The memory account-gate smoke explicitly sets both auth-bypass flags to 0 for provider, degraded-Identity, and restart launches; it stays signed out at account_required, checks no local server, retains production Identity handoff for Google/GitHub, skips Electron safeStorage probes/decrypt, and logs native vault persistence NOT EXECUTED. Native mode remains default and keeps its native encrypted-storage/restart-decrypt assertions. The single marked test copy is reused across the local profiles.

The current acceptance document was authored before this review and still describes the schema repair and renewed stage review as pending. Refresh that status when archiving this receipt and the three reviewed_node_changes records; preserve the earlier native packaged Desktop FAIL and keep exact-candidate black-box acceptance and native CI pending until their own evidence is available.

retained_client_record_boundary.client_responsibility: Electron owns account-gate startup/session orchestration and local device credential storage; the retained-client record is not an assertion of Rust ownership.
retained_client_record_boundary.associated_backend_authority: Optional, only where directly related; native::server_foundation::local_account_auth identifies server-side account lifecycle consumed by the client and does not own Electron safeStorage.
retained_client_record_boundary.test_only_retirement_criterion: Remove only the smoke memory-storage override when a deterministic packaged native-keychain fixture can test the signed-out account gate without touching a developer's Keychain. Retain Electron runtime and native client vault policy while Desktop continues to hold credentials.
